_note: SIMULATED example feeds for demonstrating the agent loop. The base forecasts are real ML forecasts on held-out days; the incident, roadworks and news items are invented examples in the format a government traffic API or news feed would return.

scenarios.label: Calm morning
scenarios.about: Nothing on the route. One crash far away, roadworks only at night.

govt_traffic.title: Minor two-car collision on the ring road, eastbound

govt_roadworks.title: Night resurfacing on the campus approach road

scenarios.label: Accident blocks the road
scenarios.about: Official feed: crash closes all lanes near the gate. A TV station confirms.

govt_traffic.title: Two-vehicle crash, all lanes blocked, emergency services on scene

news.title: Crash closes road near university gate during morning rush

scenarios.label: Roadworks close one lane
scenarios.about: Public-works permit: one of two lanes closed all morning.

govt_roadworks.title: Water-main repair: one lane closed, flagger traffic control

scenarios.label: Unverified rumour
scenarios.about: A social post claims the road is blocked. Nothing official confirms it.

news.title: "Road near the campus gate totally blocked??"

scenarios.label: Crash already cleared
scenarios.about: A crash closed the road earlier, but it reopened before the arrival hour.

news.title: Road near campus reopened after early-morning breakdown
